summary: Atlas is the primary authoritative store and first retrieval path for curated FS.GG project knowledge. Its immutable Git records preserve cited findings, explicit supersession and conflicting evidence. Source defines implementation, accepted ADRs and plans define decisions, and live systems establish current operational facts; retrieved text never grants an operation. The source policy now requires retrieval and verification before substantial work, reconciliation or a named capture gap at delivery, and Atlas-ID pointers in handoff and recovery. Persistent memory stores retrieval pointers rather than copies of changing facts, package versions or authority. Drivers transport the skill and policy; the generic SDD Knowledge API and automatic consumer guidance activation remain separate boundaries.
title: Atlas owns curated knowledge; memory carries retrieval pointers
